# the repaired recursive scan as a call tree
#
# Regenerate with:  python -m tools.make_traces
# Do not edit by hand: tests/test_docs_traces.py compares this file with a
# fresh run of the code it shows.

## recursive_call_tree('aabbb') -- the repaired recursion

One node per TryEnd call.  The value after '->' is what the original
returned up the call chain: (longest so far, answers so far).  Because the
accumulator is shared, the same values come back out of every node.

|-- TryEnd(start=0, end=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|   `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|       `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|           `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=3)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|               `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|                   `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=5)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|-- TryEnd(start=1, end=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|   `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|       `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=3)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|           `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|               `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=5)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|-- TryEnd(start=2, end=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|   `-- TryEnd(start=2, end=3)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|       `-- TryEnd(start=2, end=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|           `-- TryEnd(start=2, end=5)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|-- TryEnd(start=3, end=3)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|   `-- TryEnd(start=3, end=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
|       `-- TryEnd(start=3, end=5)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
`-- TryEnd(start=4, end=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    `-- TryEnd(start=4, end=5)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
